reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

description.narrative: Approximately 58,520 beneficiaries received food assistance (meat) through the distribution of approximately 4,180 sacrificial meat shares.

Meet the needs of the most vulnerable families in Yemen by providing meat; help heads of needy families facing difficult economic conditions who cannot secure their basic needs during Eid; support the most needy families, standing with them and giving them a sense of solidarity and social cohesion.

Procurement and distribution of 4,180 sacrificial meat shares to targeted families who cannot afford to buy sacrificial animals or provide meat during Eid, strengthening the spirit of hope and consolidating the values of giving and compassion in the Republic of Yemen.
